response_texts: What's with the Reachmen gathering in this forest? What are they, the Forsworn?
The Goji clan that rules this land are no Forsworn, no. They are a clan that is hostile even to all the other Reachmen, not merely the Forsworn.
They have been hiding in this forest for generations, hiding its existence and attacking anyone who came too close.
Then no other clan will side with them. I guess it's safe to assume there will be no outside reinforcements, then.
Correct. They are simply avenging the breach of their isolation and revelation of the secret, yes? But that is why they will come at you with that much more force. Desperation, yes?
I don't want to deal with dead soldiers, though... I can't afford that luxury.
Burn marks. Very old ones. She must have gotten them long before she was kidnapped.
O tainted soul. Can you not hear that dreamer's breathing? That bird can no longer fly, and a pleasant night is his only consolation.
The present is too cold for a wingless bird. So turn back. For we are all nothing but suffering lice. Dream and partake in Kyne's Feast of Love!
What's this bipedal rat? Looks like a Skeever...
A Skeeven. They were originally Rieklings from Solstheim, but the Thalmor mutated them with Skeever blood.
The first attempt at beast-possession, then. How intelligent are they?
They have enough intelligence to use weapons, but not enough to communicate. The Thalmor couldn't control them and discarded them in the sewer.
And of course we'll be entering the city through that sewer...
Their fertility was higher than the Thalmor expected. Apparently, they bred enough to fill the entire sewer.
But their numbers are supposed to be quite low now due to the Thalmor regularly dispatching troops to thin them out.
That's good. One thing we can thank the Thalmor for.
Quagmire... So it's a plane of nightmares, right? How in Oblivion do we get there? Do we just sleep or what?
We will have to pry the gate open from the base point where Arkved is connected to Quagmire.
In this mission, you'll have to break into Quagmire in the flesh through its transitional gates and find the Oneiromancer.
Doing that... are you sure it's safe? I don't want to get stuck in a nightmare world...
The transitional gate itself is very stable, so I wouldn't worry about that. No, it's the latent effect Quagmire has on intruders that worries me...
According to the material recovered from the Thalmor, there are numerous reports of physical changes and negative effects on the mind.
Quagmire's effects were also used for the acceleration of beast possession. It's really insane.
So that means someone's dreams could turn us into monsters? Is there any way to prevent that?
Ozwald, it's...
One should use tuning boxes, no? They are dreaming machines. Using them will allow you to see the dreams and stabilize your shape, yes?
That sounds too convenient. Does it have any side effects?
Ah, but of course! And that is why we shall let the baby here take care of them for you, yes?
This is the baby we recovered in the Cradle Woods... What a miserable, necessary thing to do.
The child was born dead, no? Do not worry about it.
If we do not use up what we can, we have no future. You are aware of that, hmm? Ozwald?
Yes... but still... no, no more of that...
It was the right thing to do. There was no choice... There never was one. Only gods in Aetherius... And all is wonderful in the world.
So, this is the Beast of Haafingar? You've done well to kill such a large beast by yourself.
Right? This has solved the case of Talos worshippers' murders. I got a large reward, too. I can now live comfortably for several years.
But this isn't the only thing that brought you here, is it?
The Thalmor were involved in this. They are using monsters like this one here and there.
No, not that. What does the Chick Trader want us to do, Cedric?
Still working so hard... But yes, I've come here on behalf of the Chick Trader.
He wants you to infiltrate a Thalmor facility and steal a certain "key". The place is called Ysmir's Howl.
Is that the Temple City of Talos? ...That's going to be troublesome.
Correct. Good luck.
This is unlike you, isn't it, Ozwald?
What? I'm not doing anything different than usual.
That new recruit of yours. Why didn't you kill them?
I decided they could be more useful as a hunter.
Is that what you told them? Tell me the real reason.
They inherited the curse from Felix. I feel like Felix is still somehow alive in them...
That's why I couldn't kill them... I wanted to keep them near. Are you happy now?
That's insane. Because of that, you attracted the Chick Trader's attention. And lately, you've been forced on some unreasonable missions, right?
Simply tasks that we've been determined to be capable of. I have no complaints.
Of course you don't. You never do. But don't forget - that rookie is not Felix. Felix is already dead.
I know that much. I know...
There is a Glenmoril witch staying in the Cradle Woods. Could she be connected to the ghoul outbreak?
The Na clan sacrifices a baby to calm the ghosts in the forest every few years, and that Glenmoril witch leads the ritual...
Perhaps we could conclude that the ghoul outbreak was caused by sacrificing our "baby". Do we have any more information about the witch?
Her name is Anem. She used to travel across the Reach and perform rituals related to fertility and childbirth.
Witches play an important part in birthing in the Reachmen society. Bringing life to this world, and sometimes taking it...
Romion, let's summarize the main points of this mission.
Your mission is to find this... "baby" that supposedly became the source of ghouls in the Cradle Woods in the western part of the Reach.
That forest is supposedly home to the Na clan of the Reachmen. Is there any possibility that they'll interfere?
I don't think so. After the ghoul outbreak, there's been no word about the Na clan. They were either destroyed by the ghouls or they moved to another location.
It's the ghosts that you should be wary of, though. They're Cuhlecain's loyalists who rebelled against Talos and were exiled and executed in that forest.
Ghosts of Cuhlecain's loyalists... I've heard about them. They're still wandering around there and seeking Cuhlecain's nonexistent successor, right?
Indeed. So don't forget to arm yourself against the undead.
What about our landing spot? That area is quite foggy. If we don't think it out well, we'll crash.
We'll prioritize safety and land at the cave where the mist is thinner. You'll continue to the field from there.
That cave seems to be submerged... We'll have to swim a little.
Your equipment will be safe - I've put waterproofing spells on it.
Very clever of you, Romion.
The stench of your blood is revolting... You are not from this city, no?
Whoever approaches the secrets of the moon falls to the beast's corruption. You shall be the prey of this Great Hunt.
Zuzu the Oneiromancer... Do we have any more information about this witch?
It seems she's a very old witch. In the old records, she's mentioned as a daughter of a Dumb Old Giant who was Ysgramor's counselor.
The only other description of her left is that she begged the Oracle Iridescent for knowledge and gained powers to come and go in dreams.
Not much to go on... That's not up to your usual standards, right, Romion? Are you all right?
I'm confused, too. In all the literature I've checked, there are no descriptions or stories related to her.
She's very cautious. She must have purged all information of herself before she left Nirn. Perhaps in Apocrypha...
Or maybe in the Green Tablet Steps of Jhunal. Neither of those is easy to reach, and even if we could, we wouldn't be able to leave at least.
It's more practical to just find her in Quagmire, then.
Ja'zel, isn't your plan relying on chance a little too much? I'm honestly really worried for the future...
"The popular notion of God kills happenstance." We are not relying on happenstance, but fate, yes?
36 Lessons of Vivec, Sermon Four? Now that's a crook's rant if there ever was one.
Even a pretender can be real as long as he believes he is. He was real, and he most definitely believed he was, no?
He was like a fish in this river. Smaller minds like yours and Ja'zel's can never hope to understand.
...There are no fish in the river now, though. Did they vanish like that Vivec?
This one does not know. Perhaps he drowned in the current or perhaps he is suffocating on the river's bank, yes?
Or perhaps the fish are still swimming in the same place, and it was simply Ja'zel and his friends that were swept downstream.
It looks like Felix is dead. Shall I get rid of him?
No, this will still work. Just hand this one the pills in the box over there. You are aware of what is inside, yes?
Yelem's mutagen activator, right? But if he becomes a monster, he'll be too difficult for an ordinary hunter to handle...
That is fine. He will become a sacrifice. For the new Chick to come, no?
The Owl will interfere for sure. Are you certain you want to do this?
Yes, that is right. They will not stand for it, and they will get involved directly. That is when we will be able to kill them.
But will it work? That'll be like a small fish biting a whale...
If their real shape appears, then all our attempts will surely fail. But they are not that stupid... No, they will simply send their avatars, surely.
You only need to get rid of some of them, yes? But be sure to give yourself enough time to get away.
Huh, I don't think it's possible to escape at all, though. I'm betting on that.
You're finally here. Romion, let's have a quick briefing on this mission.
We're going to Piper's Hill, an area currently occupied by the extremists excommunicated from the Vigil of Stendarr.
Vigil of Stendarr... What on Nirn would they excommunicate you for?
I heard they've been torturing every Daedra worshipper they could get their hands on.
Understandable ex-communication, then. So, they already kidnapped the descendant in question? And our mission is to "rescue" her?
Yes, that's right. But they are a dangerous bunch... I hope we can make it there in time.
I hope she'll be able to talk to us... Are you ready with the cure?
Yes, it's done. And don't worry, we're prepared for any other survivors you may find there, too.
What's this gold for? What's the meaning of this?
It is a payment for the sixth chick. Ja'zel found an interesting chick.
What are you saying? Explain yourself!
This one did give you a fair payment. Well, see you again.
Hey, wait a bit, damnit! I won't accept your gold!
